import requests
```
```
    api_key = config.get('dd_api_key') or os.environ.get('DD_API_KEY')
    app_key = config.get('dd_app_key') or os.environ.get('DD_APP_KEY')
    if not api_key or not app_key:
        result = {'error': 'Datadog API credentials missing'}
        return result
    headers = {
        'DD-API-KEY': api_key,
        'DD-APPLICATION-KEY': app_key,
        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    }
    query = f"{payload['query_a']}, {payload['query_b']}"
    data = {
        'from': payload['from_timestamp'],
        'to': payload['to_timestamp'],
        'query': query
    }
    api_response = requests.post(
        'https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1/query',
        headers=headers,
        json=data
    )
    api_response.raise_for_status()
    resp_data = api_response.json()
    series = resp_data.get('series', [])
    pointlist_a = series[0]['pointlist'] if len(series) > 0 else []
    pointlist_b = series[1]['pointlist'] if len(series) > 1 else []
    values_a = [point[1] for point in pointlist_a if point[1] is not None]
    avg_a = sum(values_a) / len(values_a) if values_a else None
    values_b = [point[1] for point in pointlist_b if point[1] is not None]
    avg_b = sum(values_b) / len(values_b) if values_b else None
    diff = avg_a - avg_b if avg_a is not None and avg_b is not None else None
    ratio = avg_a / avg_b if avg_a is not None and avg_b is not None and avg_b != 0 else None
